description: Translation coverage of the Verbaly project as numbers per locale: total messages, translated, machine translations awaiting review (drafts), broken, and translations written for an older source text (outdated). It scans the source like verbaly_extract but writes nothing. Read-only. For the entries behind the numbers, use verbaly_missing (what is missing or broken) or verbaly_drafts (each draft with its source text).

root.description: Project root holding verbaly.config (defaults to the server working directory)

name: verbaly_status

broken.description: Present but not rendering what the source renders

outdated.description: Translated from an older source text: update them, or a human keeps them

messages.description: Messages the project has, source catalog plus code

stateProblem.description: The state file could not be read, so drafts and outdated are counted as zero

title: Translation coverage
